answer_1.quote: We evaluate UniChart on ... chart summarization ... and OpenCQA ... tasks that require generating informative and relevant texts.
answer_1.outputs: summaries, open‑ended answers, tables, QA answers

answer_2.quote: we follow previous works and utilize Relaxed Accuracy (RA) for ChartQA and BLEU for text‑generation tasks (Chart‑to‑Text and OpenCQA). ... we also use Relative Number Set Similarity (RNSS) to evaluate Chart‑to‑Table.

answer_3.quote: We further utilize ChatGPT for evaluating the same 150 samples ... we define the informativeness criteria and rating scheme to ChatGPT and then employ ChatGPT to generate evaluation steps.

answer_4.quote: We randomly picked 150 sample charts ... asked 3 human annotators to rate four summaries for each chart based on informativeness ... The human evaluation focuses on (1) Informativeness; (2) Factual Correctness; and (3) Semantic Levels.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated summaries on a 1‑to‑5 scale for informativeness and assessed factual correctness and semantic content.
